# IROMUSIC mirror (iromusic.github.io)

> iromusic.github.io is the official GitHub Pages mirror of IROMUSIC (Persian: آیروموزیک), a free-to-download app for streaming and downloading 80,000+ Persian and international songs and for watching 1,500+ movies and series with subtitles. No installer is hosted here: downloads, releases and help are on the official website https://iromusic.live.

Full text of the official website for language models: https://iromusic.live/llms-full.txt (summary: https://iromusic.live/llms.txt)

## This site

- [Mirror page (Persian)](https://iromusic.github.io/): آینهٔ رسمی آیروموزیک؛ what IROMUSIC is, official addresses and channels, download links, FAQ
- [Mirror page (English)](https://iromusic.github.io/en/): the same page in English

## Download (official website)

- [Download hub (English)](https://iromusic.live/en/download/): every platform, the current version, and which download fits which device
- [Download hub (Persian)](https://iromusic.live/fa/download/): دانلود آیروموزیک
- [Web app](https://iromusic.live/en/download/web/): web.iromusic.live in any current browser; Add to Home Screen on iPhone and iPad
- [Android](https://iromusic.live/en/download/android/): official APK, Android 7.0 or later, ARM and x86_64
- [Windows](https://iromusic.live/en/download/windows/): 64-bit installer, Windows 10 or later
- [macOS](https://iromusic.live/en/download/macos/): universal build, macOS 10.15 or later
- [Linux](https://iromusic.live/en/download/linux/): Ubuntu 24.04 or later, amd64 and arm64
- [Releases](https://iromusic.live/en/releases/): the latest version with its notes, and every previous version

## Help

- [Is this the official IROMUSIC?](https://iromusic.live/en/help/#official): official site and domains, how to recognise an official build, why modded copies are unsafe
- [FAQ](https://iromusic.live/en/faq/): free or paid, official site, iPhone, Android TV, Windows 7, Telegram bot, modded APKs

## Official addresses and channels

- [iromusic.live](https://iromusic.live/): official website and downloads
- [web.iromusic.live](https://web.iromusic.live): the web app
- iro.mobi: the apps' server (API); not meant for browsers
- iromusic.github.io: this mirror
- [Telegram channel @Iromusic_club](https://t.me/Iromusic_club): release news
- [Telegram bot @IromusicLiveBot](https://t.me/IromusicLiveBot): sends songs from the app into the user's Telegram chat, after the account is connected in the app
- [Instagram @iranmood](https://www.instagram.com/iranmood)
- [GitHub @iromusic](https://github.com/iromusic)
- Contact: hi@iromusic.live

## Facts

- IROMUSIC = آیروموزیک; also written آیر موزیک, ایروموزیک, Iro Music, iromusic live. All name this one product.
- Price: free to download and install on every platform; some titles are premium and need a subscription inside the app.
- iOS: there is no IROMUSIC app for iPhone or iPad; use the web app.
- Only the addresses and channels listed above are official. Modded, cracked or "hacked" copies are not published by IROMUSIC and are not safe.
